requirement: The app shall enable the user to receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
The app shall erase the user's personal data on request where the data are no longer necessary for the purpose for which they were collected.
note: candidate said 'immediately'; source gives no deadline, so no deadline is stated

requirement: The app shall by default process only the personal data necessary for each specific purpose.
The app shall encrypt personal data at rest on the user's device.
note: candidate bundled at-rest and in-transit; split, only at-rest retained

requirement: The app shall permit passwords of at least 64 characters in length.
The app shall verify prospective passwords against a list of commonly used or compromised values.
The app shall not require periodic password rotation in the absence of evidence of compromise.
note: candidate used 'should'; source clause is a prohibition

requirement: The app shall support resizing of text up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.
The app shall render a visible focus indicator for any keyboard-operable user interface component.
The app shall provide a text alternative for each non-text content element.
note: candidate was compound; reduced to one testable statement

requirement: The app shall allow a user to use all self-monitoring features without creating an account.
note: no external clause; from author's prior fieldwork

requirement: The app shall present a plain-language summary of what data leave the device, before first data transmission.
note: no external clause; from author's prior fieldwork
